scope: the corrected bucket matched and all fault requests stayed HTTP 200, but routine readiness and scrape traffic diluted the slow-request ratio just below the locked burn threshold; the router was restored and no successful alert receipt was written
root_cause: the 2 QPS fault stream was not dominant enough relative to fast operational traffic counted by the same gateway histogram
remediation: retain the SLO threshold and raise only the controlled latency fault arrival rate from 2 QPS to 4 QPS
